_: The apps this repository's SideStore source lists (ci/sidestore_source.py): each from the releases tagged <tag>-<n> that carry an .ipa asset. Names are working titles; the names are Paul's.

apps.name: Pivot
apps.subtitle: The never-ending rondo; you the pivot
apps.localizedDescription: A sketch. You are the holding midfielder in an endless rondo. When the ball comes, time softens to your pace; the passes you could make glow and close as the pressers shift. Move a finger to look around; let it go fast to pass. Working title.

apps.name: Pulse
apps.subtitle: A constellation keeping its shape; each pass a note
apps.localizedDescription: A sketch. The same rondo as light: teammates a drifting constellation, pressers dark fields, the ball a pulse; each pass a note, so a good sequence is a melody. Working title.

apps.name: Rondo Garden
apps.subtitle: An endless rondo that draws its own pitch
apps.localizedDescription: A sketch. A slow, endless rondo on pale ground; every pass leaves its trail in ink and the pitch is slowly drawn. Shake to wash it clean. Working title.

apps.name: Ghost
apps.subtitle: A real match, through any player’s eyes
apps.localizedDescription: A sketch. Croatia 3-5 Spain (Euro 2020) from StatsBomb open data, fetched when it opens, replayed from above or through any player’s eyes, Busquets first. Faded figures are inferred. WHAT IF changes one thing and lets the agents play on beside the real match. Data: StatsBomb. Working title.

apps.name: Light
apps.subtitle: Every pass Busquets made, as light
apps.localizedDescription: A sketch. Every pass Sergio Busquets made in StatsBomb’s open data, drawn as light on a dark pitch, building over time. Data: StatsBomb. Working title.

apps.name: Watch
apps.subtitle: Agents playing football; your hand on the dials
apps.localizedDescription: A sketch. Eleven a side (or a rondo) playing itself; drag on a side to change how it presses and how much it risks, pinch to change its shape, and watch the tactics change. Working title.

apps.name: Eyes
apps.subtitle: The pivot, over your shoulder
apps.localizedDescription: A sketch. The rondo in 3D from just behind you: drag to turn your head, flick up to pass at the pace of your finger; the pressers lean where they read your look. Working title.
